gloss: a world apart; incomparably different; on a different level

definitions.gloss: a world apart; incomparably different; on a different level
definitions.explanation: so different in quality or degree that comparison is hardly possible; leagues apart

examples.japanese: {味|あじ}が{段違|だんちが}いだ。
examples.english: The flavor is on a completely different level.

examples.japanese: プロとアマでは{段違|だんちが}いの{差|さ}がある。
examples.english: There's a world of difference between pros and amateurs.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいモデルは{性能|せいのう}が{段違|だんちが}いに{良|よ}い。
examples.english: The new model is incomparably better in performance.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}と{今年|ことし}では、チームの{実力|じつりょく}が{段違|だんちが}いだ。
examples.english: The team's ability is on a completely different level compared to last year.

notes:
Literally means being on different steps or levels ({段|だん} = step/level, {違|ちが}い = difference). Describes a gap in quality or ability that is not just noticeable but dramatic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {段違|だんちが}いの{差|さ}: an overwhelming difference
- {段違|だんちが}いに{良|よ}い: incomparably better
- {段違|だんちが}いの{実力|じつりょく}: ability on a different level
- {段違|だんちが}いに{速|はや}い: incomparably faster

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {桁違|けたちが}い: on a different order of magnitude; emphasizes numerical scale, while {段違|だんちが}い emphasizes quality or skill
- {格段|かくだん}に: remarkably, significantly; more formal and used adverbially
- {雲泥|うんでい}の{差|さ}: a world of difference (literally "the difference between clouds and mud"); more literary

NOTE:
Also used in gymnastics: {段違|だんちが}い{平行棒|へいこうぼう} means uneven parallel bars.
